text:
pagerbot: PAGER: P0 - detected multi-GPU collective stall affecting run-9921 in pool tp-eu-central. Symptoms: persistent NCCL stalls during allreduce phase, sudden CUDA Xid 79 on node gpu-eu-04, container restart noted. Impact: real-time inference timeouts for several customers.

oncall_ash: picking this up. tagging oncall and infra. Ash here — can someone paste the pod status and recent driver logs?

sre_kia: pod status:
```
$ kubectl -n inference get pods | grep run-9921
run-9921-worker-0   Running   gpu-eu-03
run-9921-worker-1   CrashLoopBackOff   gpu-eu-04
run-9921-worker-2   Running   gpu-eu-05
```

sre_kia: dmesg from gpu-eu-04 shows repeated "NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:af:00) 79" and kernel OOM events tied to container cgroup. nvidia-smi shortly before crash shows memory usage spikes to ~99% on GPU0/1/2.

ml_infra_lee: model config: tp=4, microbatch=4, prefix_cache enabled with aggressive rollover at seq=2300. runtime uses q8_0 quantization and the runtime's prefix GC happens during eval boundary. suspect transient memory spike on rollover plus tp cross-node rendezvous triggers one rank to OOM, leaving remaining ranks blocked in NCCL.

oncall_ash: can we reproduce a reduced repro in staging? immediate mitigation needed though — customers are seeing 504s.

prod_lead_sam: priority P0 for public-facing customers. Start mitigations: 1) isolate node gpu-eu-04, 2) disable prefix cache for run-9921 variant, 3) set NCCL_ASYNC_ERROR_HANDLING=1 to allow communicator teardown, 4) decrease collectives timeout. Who can push config?

deploybot: NOTE: automated canary pipeline available. Recommend patching a canary first.

ml_infra_lee: proposing steps:
- Apply temp model override: prefix_cache: false (canary only)
- Set envs: "NCCL_ASYNC_ERROR_HANDLING=1", "NCCL_TIMEOUT=30000" (or runtime equivalent)
- If node has repeated Xid79s, cordon and reboot to clear driver state

oncall_ash: applying canary now. PATCH to model config and trigger canary rollout.

deploybot: rollout started for run-9921-canary (3 pods)

sre_kia: cordoning node gpu-eu-04 and draining suspected pods to force restart on other healthy hosts.
```
kubectl cordon node/gpu-eu-04
kubectl drain node/gpu-eu-04 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
```

oncall_ash: cordon/drain complete. node reboot scheduled. grabbing driver logs for upload.

sre_kia: node rebooted, driver reloaded to recommended 525.x build we vetted last month. no persistent kernel oops after reboot.

deploybot: canary pods are up on gpu-eu-03 and gpu-eu-05 with prefix_cache disabled. monitoring metrics for the last 10 minutes.

ml_infra_lee: canary observation: no NCCL stalls observed during previously failing kv rollover window; memory peaks are ~20% lower. good sign.

cs_ana: customer impact: affected orgs: OmniML (org 781) and ScoutAI (org 812). OmniML reported increased tail latencies and intermittent 504s for background model scoring. total affected requests ~630 in last 45 minutes. notifying both customers and offering credits.

prod_lead_sam: draft customer update: "We experienced a multi-GPU serving disruption causing intermittent inference timeouts. We isolated and rebooted an affected node, deployed a configuration change to prevent transient memory spikes, and observed healthy canary runs. We will follow up with a detailed incident report and remediation plan." add time window and mention credits.

oncall_ash: after canary success, rolling change to all run-9921 workers now. will also set NCCL_ASYNC_ERROR_HANDLING env and lower the collective timeout.

deploybot: rolling update initiated -> workers restarted with new config and envs.

sre_kia: post-rollout checks: no new Xid79 events in driver logs for 25 minutes, NCCL collectives completing normally. job run-9921 throughput back to baseline.

ml_infra_lee: immediate remedial items:
- Keep prefix_cache disabled for this model variant until we implement improved prefix GC and conservative rollover threshold
- Add a runtime fast-fail: if a rank exits uncleanly during a collective, kill the job to avoid a stuck global rendezvous
- Add telemetry for kv-cache memory deltas across ranks and alert on >15% sudden increase

sre_kia: longer-term infra items: automated node cordon on >3 Xid79s in 10 minutes, regression test in staging for tp=4 with heavy prefix GC, and validate driver versions across fleet.

cs_ana: sending customer messages now; including estimated window 2024-06-23T14:20Z to 2024-06-23T15:05Z and note of service credits.

prod_lead_sam: assign postmortem to ml_infra_lee and sre_kia. request timeline + root cause analysis within 48 hours.

oncall_ash: closing pager after monitoring for 30 more minutes. all services stable. final logs bundle uploaded: s3://redwood-incident-logs/run-9921/1719123456.tar.gz

pagerbot: RESOLVED: P0 - multi-GPU collective hang mitigated. probable cause: kv/prefix cache rollover causing transient per-rank memory spikes and subsequent GPU OOM (Xid79) during tp4 rendezvous. mitigations: disable prefix cache, upgrade driver on node, enable NCCL async error handling and lowered collectives timeout. postmortem assigned.

cs_ana: thanks all :thumbsup: please cc ops and customers on postmortem.

participants: pagerbot, oncall_ash, sre_kia, ml_infra_lee, prod_lead_sam, cs_ana, deploybot
